description: Routing table of the pack, read by .claude/runtime/route-task.mjs. `intents` map task keywords to an ordered capability list (the capability registry resolves each capability to an executor agent, its skills, tools, validation and evidence); `highImpactSignals` mark task text that needs human approval of the named authority action class. Source file: edited by hand per batch; the resolved view is the output of route-task.mjs.
